plainTranslation: The Moon person and Sun person often stand on opposite sides of the same room: one leading from feeling, one from identity. The attraction can be strong because each carries what the other notices. The work is trading perspective instead of casting one person as too needy or too self-focused.

summaryShort: There's a strong pull here, but you may not always feel like you're coming from the same place. One person's way of being can bring up a lot of feelings in the other person, sometimes in a good way, sometimes in a "why am I reacting like this?" way.
summaryDeep:
There's a strong pull here, but you may not always feel like you're coming from the same place. One person's way of being can bring up a lot of feelings in the other person, sometimes in a good way, sometimes in a "why am I reacting like this?" way.

At its best, you balance each other out. One person brings direction, confidence, or clarity. The other brings care, sensitivity, and emotional reality. You may feel like this person has something you need, even when they also get on your nerves.

The problem is that it can turn into a standoff. One person feels unseen. The other feels like nothing they do is enough.

Don't make it a competition over whose needs matter more. Say what you need, listen to what they need, and meet somewhere in the middle.
